mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 5.5% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that signal weakening corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances with UNRATE > 5.5, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous weakening in labor market participation (PAYEMS) and consumer credit demand (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances with both PAYEMS and RSAFS declining, or Rank IC for interaction < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts above 1.05 million units signals strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with HOUST > 1050 (thousands), or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 105.0 (index 2017=100) indicates weakening manufacturing activity, reducing corporate profit expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances with INDPRO < 105.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) above 440 billion dollars signals robust consumer spending, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with RSAFS > 440000 (thousands), or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 235), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances with CPIAUCSL > 235, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A low level of employment (PAYEMS < 140000 thousand) indicates a weak labor market, reducing consumer spending and corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances with PAYEMS < 140000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.
